Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated wooden bridge DECK SPRITE for Magic Mail mobile map. Genuine TRANSPARENT background. Strict TOP DOWN orthographic view, NO perspective or tilt baked in. A vertical narrow rectangular bridge made of SEVEN broad horizontal honey-orange rounded wooden logs stacked along the vertical axis. Each log spans the full width of the deck, has warm deep-orange lower shading and a smooth bright gold curved highlight, with a small visible round log end on the left and right. Two thin dark-brown rope ties along the long sides. SIMPLE clean 2D hand-drawn casual game style, broad smooth color gradients, cheerful and glossy, thin uniform cream-white outer outline. No detailed wood grain, no nails, no railings, no ground, no water, no detached shadows, no posts sticking out, no scenery or text. Complete bridge centered with ample transparent padding. The game will project and slant this sprite onto curved terrain; don't paint any camera perspective.
